k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent and expert archer
st: Clint takes aim at Thor from a perch as he fights his way to Mjolnir.
Loki takes control of Clint, until Natasha knocks him free and he fights with the Avengers.
Clint hides the team at his secret family farm, helps save Sokovia, then retires.
Clint comes out of retirement for Steve, is locked in the Raft, and is broken out by Steve.
Clint is said to have taken a deal after the Raft and is under house arrest with his family.
After his family vanishes, Clint becomes Ronin, then joins the Time Heist and loses Natasha on Vormir.
In New York at Christmas, Clint teams up with Kate Bishop against the Tracksuit Mafia and Kingpin.
Laura hosts the Avengers at the Barton farm while expecting her third child.
Laura turns to dust in the Snap with her children during a picnic at the farm.
Restored when Bruce reverses the Snap, Laura calls Clint, and he comes home to his family after the battle.
Laura helps Clint by phone, and he brings her back her old S.H.I.E.L.D. watch.
Lila meets the Avengers on the Barton farm.
Lila practices archery with Clint at the farm, then turns to dust in the Snap.
Restored, Lila reunites with her father at home after the final battle.
Lila spends Christmas with her father.
Cooper meets the Avengers on the Barton farm.
Cooper turns to dust in the Snap with his mother and siblings at the farm.
Restored, Cooper reunites with his father at home after the final battle.
Cooper spends Christmas with his father.
Laura gives birth to Nathaniel, named after Natasha.
Nathaniel turns to dust in the Snap with his mother and siblings at the farm.
Restored, Nathaniel reunites with his father at home after the final battle.
Nathaniel spends Christmas with his father.

replace.k: Carol Danvers's best friend, an Air Force pilot
st: Maria tells Carol about her past, then flies beside her to help the Skrulls escape the Kree.
Monica learns that Maria, who led S.W.O.R.D., died of cancer while Monica was gone in the Blip.
In 1995, young Monica urges her mother to fly with Carol against the Kree.
Monica vanishes in the Blip, leaving her mother behind.
Back from the Blip, Monica enters the Westview Hex for S.W.O.R.D. and gains powers.
Monica's powers become linked with Carol's and Kamala's, and she ends up stranded in another universe.
Out of prison, Scott is recruited by Hank Pym as Ant-Man and stops Darren Cross.
Scott joins Steve's side as Giant-Man, is locked in the Raft, and is broken out.
Scott is said to have taken a deal after the Raft and is under house arrest.
Under house arrest, Scott helps Hank and Hope rescue Janet, then is stranded in the Quantum Realm.
Free after five years, Scott brings the time travel idea to the Avengers and fights Thanos.
Pulled into the Quantum Realm, Scott fights Kang to save Cassie and gets home with his family.

k: Natasha's sister, a Red Room Widow
Black Widow, one of the New Avengers
st: Freed from Red Room control, Yelena teams up with Natasha to take down Dreykov and free the Widows.
Visiting a former Widow to free her mind, Yelena turns to dust in the Blip.
At Natasha's grave, Valentina tells Yelena that Clint Barton killed her sister.
Yelena hunts Clint in New York, then learns the truth about Natasha's death and lets him go.
Yelena leads a team of outcasts to save New York from the Void, and they become the New Avengers.
Now the Black Widow, Yelena helps Spider-Man dig into Damage Control's secrets.
May meets Tony Stark when he visits her nephew in Queens.
May walks in on Peter in his Spider-Man suit.
Like Peter, May is among the people who vanish in the Blip.
May attends Tony Stark's funeral with Peter.
May runs charity events and starts dating Happy Hogan.
May helps the villains from other universes, and the Green Goblin kills her.
May appears in a memory Peter shares with Jean Grey.
Ned finds out Peter is Spider-Man and becomes his guy in the chair.
Ned creates a distraction so Peter can slip off a school bus.
Ned is among the Midtown students who vanish in the Blip.
Ned reunites with Peter at school after the Blip.
Ned dates Betty Brant on the school trip to Europe.
Ned learns he can open portals, helps cure the villains, and forgets Peter after Strange's spell.
Ned shares an apartment with MJ, builds a Spidey Tracker app, and meets Peter again.
Michelle, an aloof member of the decathlon team, tells Peter her friends call her MJ.
MJ is among the Midtown students who vanish in the Blip.
MJ figures out Peter is Spider-Man, and they start dating.
MJ helps Peter cure the villains, then forgets him after Strange's spell.
Possessed by Jean Grey, MJ is saved by Spider-Man, and he tells her a truth she cannot remember.
Flash teases Peter at school and on the decathlon team.
Flash is among the Midtown students who vanish in the Blip.
Flash livestreams the class trip across Europe.
Flash tries to cash in on knowing Spider-Man.

replace.k: A classmate who co-hosts the school news
st: Betty co-hosts Midtown's morning news show.
Betty is among the Midtown students who vanish in the Blip.
Betty dates Ned on the class trip to Europe, then they break up.
Betty becomes an unpaid intern at The Daily Bugle.
Betty is back at Midtown as the school reacts to Peter being Spider-Man.
